table.name: employee
table.purpose: One row per employee (the sample data are English rugby players, so this appears to be a roster/staff table). Referenced by hiring and evaluation tables, which likely record each employee's hiring and performance evaluation records.

col_001.name: employee_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each employee. Referenced by hiring.col_001 and evaluation.col_001.

col_002.name: full_name
col_002.description: Employee's full name (first + last), unique per row in this sample.

col_003.name: age
col_003.description: Employee's age in years (values 23-43, plausible human ages).

col_004.name: team
col_004.description: Team/club the employee belongs to (e.g. Bath, Bristol, Wasps, Leicester, Sale). Could alternatively be a city/office location, but the values are English rugby club names, so 'team/club' is the stronger reading.

table.name: evaluation
table.purpose: Yearly salary evaluations for employees: one row per employee per evaluation year with the resulting salary amount (likely in GBP).

col_001.name: employee_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the employee being evaluated; references employee.col_001 (e.g. 2 -> 'Lee Mars', 4 -> 'Jason Hobson').

col_003.name: salary
col_003.description: Salary amount set by the evaluation, in the range 2900-4000 (currency unknown, plausibly GBP given the employee names).

table.name: hiring
table.purpose: Records employment/hiring events linking an employee to a shop in a given year, with a flag (likely whether the hiring is current/active or full-time). One row per hiring record.

col_001.name: employee_id
col_001.description: Reference to employee.col_001 (e.g. Lee Mears, Phil Vickery). Also statistically joins to shop.col_001, but the employee reading is more consistent with a hiring table; the shop join may be coincidental given the small sample. Marked tentative because two accepted joins exist.

col_002.name: hiring_id
col_002.description: Primary key of the hiring table; unique integer identifier per hiring record.

col_003.name: hiring_year
col_003.description: Year of hiring, stored as VARCHAR but containing 4-digit years 2003-2013.

col_004.name: is_active
col_004.description: Boolean flag stored as 'T'/'F' (5 true, 2 false). Likely indicates whether the hiring is current/active; the exact semantic (active vs. e.g. full-time) cannot be confirmed from values alone.

table.name: shop
table.purpose: Despite the table name 'shop', this is a table of Finnish football clubs (Veikkausliiga teams), one row per club, with city, home stadium, capacity and head coach. Renamed/misnamed table; 'shop' likely a placeholder. Referenced by 'hiring' (likely coach hirings).

col_001.name: club_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each club. Referenced by hiring.col_001.

col_002.name: club_name
col_002.description: Name of the football club (e.g. HJK, FC Inter, KuPS, IFK Mariehamn) — Finnish top-league clubs.

col_003.name: city
col_003.description: Home city of the club (Helsinki, Espoo, Turku, Kuopio, Lahti, etc.).

col_004.name: stadium
col_004.description: Home stadium/ground name (Finnair Stadium, Veritas Stadion, Tehtaan kenttä, etc.).

col_006.name: head_coach
col_006.description: Name of the club's head coach (Antti Muurinen, Mika Lehkosuo, Job Dragtsma, etc.).
